Tom (Marketing): quick topic call  need to lock webinar topic and speakers for May slot. ideas: benchmark-led demo + customer snippet?
Maya (Growth): benchmark demo + 10-min customer sounds best for conversions.
Sean (Content): agree. propose a 30m format with a 10min demo showing latency vs cost.
Rachel (Ops): greenroom free May 19 afternoon. ops can support live demo with canary fallback.
Tom (Marketing): ok lock May 19. Sean to draft 3 short abstracts by EOD. Maya to reach out to AcmeHealth for customer slot.
DeployBot: Preflight scheduled for 2026-05-19T14:00:00Z  will run quota and uptime checks.
Tom (Marketing): run-of-show (30m): 00:00-02 host intro, 02-12 demo+benchmarks, 12-22 customer story+Q, 22-30 CTAs + poll.
Maya (Growth): CTA A: gated benchmark report -> route to AE. CTA B: self-serve playbook -> nurture. Ops can AB test routing?
Rachel (Ops): yes  will create two forms and Zapier rules for `webinar_source`. also scheduling rehearsals May 12 (tech) and May 17 (speaker).
Sean (Content): follow-up assets: 3-slide pack + benchmark snippet. I'll prepare prompts and demo script.
Tom (Marketing): owners: Tom(topic), Maya(customer), Rachel(ops), Sean(content). reconvene Tue EOD to finalize.
